basic_details.job_title: AIIMS New Delhi Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Data Entry Operator post is open on contract basis in an ICMR-funded research project of the Department of Plastic, Reconstructive & Burns Surgery, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, with a consolidated salary of Rs. 29,200/-. The essential qualification is Intermediate or 12th pass in science stream, with DOEACC 'A' level and/or 2 years' EDP experience, plus a typing speed of at least 15000 key depressions per hour. Interested candidates must fill the Google form latest by 5:30 pm on 8 December 2026.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi
Department of Plastic, Reconstructive & Burns Surgery
To conduct pre-compliance, gap analysis and clinical tolerability study of biomimetic silk fibroin- based wound healing dressing (Wo Under Patch) Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs)

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is in the Department of Plastic, Reconstructive & Burns Surgery, located in the Burns & Plastic Surgery Block of AIIMS, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi. It serves an ICMR-funded project studying a biomimetic silk fibroin-based wound healing dressing for diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs), covering pre-compliance, gap analysis and clinical tolerability. The notice is issued by Dr. Maneesh Singhal, Professor & Head and Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Intermediate or 12th pass in science stream from recognized board. With DOEACC 'A' level from a recognized institute and/or 2 years' experience in EDP work in Government, Autonomous PSU or any other recognized organization. A speed test of not less than 15000 key depressions per hour through speed test on computer. Bachelor's degree in Computer Application / IT / Computer Science from a recognized institution / University. A speed test of not less than 15000 key depressions per hour through speed test on computer. The notice marks the desirable qualification "As per ICMR rules". The age limit printed for the Data Entry Operator post is 30. Relaxation is as per AIIMS/ICMR rules. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Data Entry Operator
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested and eligible candidates to fill a Google form with their brief information. This information is used for shortlisting. Open the Google form at https://forms.gle/J3Y99bXzVUDQLjHv9 , or scan the QR code printed in the notice. Fill in your brief information in the form. Submit the form latest by 5:30 pm on 8 December 2026. The notice does not mention any document to attach or any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on the basis of the information filled in the Google form. The interview will be done in offline/online mode. Details of the interview will be sent only to shortlisted candidates through email. The speed test of 15000 key depressions per hour on computer is part of the essential qualification; the notice does not say when it will be held.
